capabilities: Extract the current selection into a new linked note
Extract H1-H4 heading sections into separate notes
Rebuild the source note as an index of links
Copy YAML properties into extracted notes
Add backlinks and Next links between extracted notes
extras: The manifest description notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is by manually copying the folder into the vault rather than through the community plugin store.
problem: Long notes are hard to navigate and split by hand, and Obsidian has no built-in way to break a note into linked section notes while keeping the original as an index.

relations.evidence: With Obsidian's page preview or the Hover Editor community plugin enabled, hovering that link shows the extracted note

summary: Note splitting tool that extracts selections or heading sections into linked notes and rebuilds the source note as an index of links.
